title: World Graph Studio provider Template definition
description: Strict portable authoring profile for Template_Repository::upsert_provider_template(). JSON configuration shapes are objects even where the PHP runtime accepts array compatibility forms. The owning Connection ID is supplied separately and is not part of this object.

provider_type.description: Registered adapter slug; it must exactly match the owning Connection.

provider_template_id.description: Stable remote operation, model, endpoint, or tool identifier.

input.description: Safe provider defaults; runtime prompts and resolved media bindings do not belong here.

provider_schema.description: Bounded, non-secret reference schema used for validation and operator guidance.

configuration.description: Additional non-secret provider configuration merged without erasing omitted operator-owned values.

version.description: Optional provider model or schema version.
